CANCELLATION / SUBMITTED

Please contact the insurer to request cancellation.

The proposal has already been sent. The marketplace has not cancelled it.

Use the insurer’s verified contact route

The final screen must show the source-verified contact method, application reference and relevant policy/process information. No contact route has been supplied for this preview.

Keep the record handy

Retain your application, payment and submission reference. Cancellation eligibility and refund handling depend on the insurer’s applicable process.

Help finding the contact routeView submission record
About premium changes

The displayed premium is based on the recorded details and quote version. Changes to PIN code, age, health or other disclosures, cover, riders, policy term or payment options may change the premium or eligibility. Insurer review may also revise an offer. Review the updated details, price and terms before accepting. After payment, an increase may require an additional payment and a reduction is handled through a tracked refund. All payments and refunds in this preview are simulated.
